title: Turn Left
hook: The rental car guy had one warning: if the GPS tells you to turn where there's no road... don't. And never unplug it.
lines: The man at the rental counter in Nevada slid me the keys... and one warning.
If the GPS ever tells you to turn where there's no road... don't. And whatever you do, don't unplug it.
I laughed. Then I drove four hundred miles of empty desert, alone, at night.
Around two a.m., the screen flickered. In half a mile... turn left.
There was no road. Just sand... and one porch light, far out in the dark.
I kept driving. Turn left. Turn left. Turn left.
Then the voice got softer. Slower. And it said my name.
I yanked the cord out of the dash.
The screen died. The car went silent.
Then, way back on the empty highway behind me... a pair of headlights turned on.
They followed me all the way home. When I pulled into my driveway at dawn, they were gone.
I locked the door. I almost laughed.
Then my phone lit up on the kitchen table, all by itself.
